Results.Title: Stale enabled user accounts
Results.Message: No enabled user accounts are older than 90 days without a logon.
Results.Recommendation: Confirm with the owners, then disable the accounts and move them to a quarantine OU before deletion.

Results.Title: Stale enabled computer accounts
Results.Message: No enabled computer accounts are older than 90 days without a logon.
Results.Recommendation: Disable computer accounts that have not authenticated within the threshold and delete them after a grace period.

Results.Title: Passwords that never expire
Results.Message: 1 enabled account(s) have passwords that never expire.
Results.Recommendation: Move service accounts to group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA). For people, remove the flag or enforce a long passphrase with a fine-grained password policy.

Results.Title: Accounts that do not require a password
Results.Message: No enabled accounts have PasswordNotRequired set.
Results.Recommendation: Clear the flag with Set-ADUser -PasswordNotRequired $false and set a strong password on each account.

Results.Title: Reversible encryption or DES-only Kerberos
Results.Message: No enabled accounts use reversible encryption or DES-only Kerberos.
Results.Recommendation: Clear AllowReversiblePasswordEncryption and "Use only Kerberos DES encryption types", then reset the password so new keys are generated.

Results.Title: Built-in Administrator account
Results.Message: The built-in Administrator is enabled with a password set 30 days ago.
Results.Recommendation: Use named admin accounts for daily work, rotate the built-in Administrator password and keep it in a vault, or disable it if your recovery process allows.

Results.Title: Unconstrained delegation on non-DC computers
Results.Message: 1 non-DC computer(s) are trusted for unconstrained delegation.
Results.Recommendation: Replace unconstrained delegation with constrained or resource-based constrained delegation, and add admins to Protected Users.

Results.Title: Domain controllers are registered in DNS
Results.Message: All 2 domain controller(s) are registered in DNS.
Results.Recommendation: On the missing DC, run nltest /dsregdns or restart the Netlogon service, then check that DNS dynamic updates are allowed for the zone.

Results.Title: Unlinked Group Policy Objects
Results.Message: 1 GPO(s) are not linked to any site, domain or OU.
Results.Recommendation: Back up and delete GPOs that are no longer needed, or document why they are kept.

Results.Title: Empty or fully disabled Group Policy Objects
Results.Message: No empty or fully disabled GPOs were found.
Results.Recommendation: Remove empty GPOs, or re-enable the section that holds settings if it was disabled by mistake.

Results.Title: Domain and forest functional level
Results.Message: Domain (Windows2016Domain) and forest (Windows2016Forest) meet the minimum functional level.
Results.Recommendation: Retire domain controllers running older Windows Server versions, then raise the domain and forest functional levels.

Results.Title: FSMO roles are held by existing domain controllers
Results.Message: All FSMO roles are held by current domain controllers.
Results.Recommendation: Transfer the role to a healthy DC with Move-ADDirectoryServerOperationMasterRole, or seize it if the old holder is permanently gone.

Results.Title: Domain controller service ports are reachable
Results.Message: Network checks were skipped (-SkipNetworkCheck).
Results.Recommendation: Confirm the DC services are running and that firewalls between clients and DCs allow the AD ports. LDAPS (636) failing usually means no valid DC certificate.

Results.Title: Domain controller operating systems are supported
Results.Message: All domain controllers run a supported operating system.
Results.Recommendation: Replace unsupported domain controllers with Windows Server 2019 or later and plan upgrades for versions nearing end of support.

Results.Title: Domain controller and Global Catalog redundancy
Results.Message: 2 writable domain controllers and 2 Global Catalogs.
Results.Recommendation: Run at least two writable domain controllers per domain and make at least two of them Global Catalogs.

Results.Title: AD Recycle Bin is enabled
Results.Message: The AD Recycle Bin is enabled.
Results.Recommendation: Enable it with Enable-ADOptionalFeature "Recycle Bin Feature" -Scope ForestOrConfigurationSet -Target <forest>. This cannot be undone.

Results.Title: Accounts without Kerberos pre-authentication (AS-REP roasting)
Results.Message: All enabled accounts require Kerberos pre-authentication.
Results.Recommendation: Clear "Do not require Kerberos preauthentication" on each account. If an application needs it, give that account a long random password.

Results.Title: User accounts with service principal names (Kerberoasting)
Results.Message: 1 user account(s) have an SPN. None are privileged.
Results.Recommendation: Remove SPNs from privileged accounts. Move services to gMSAs, or use 25+ character random passwords and AES-only encryption on remaining service accounts.

Results.Title: krbtgt password age
Results.Message: The krbtgt password was last set 912 days ago (limit 180).
Results.Recommendation: Reset the krbtgt password twice, waiting for full replication between resets, using Microsoft's New-KrbtgtKeys.ps1 script.

Results.Title: LAPS coverage of workstations and member servers
Results.Message: LAPS manages 66.7% of 3 computer(s) (Windows LAPS).
Results.Recommendation: Deploy Windows LAPS through Group Policy or Intune to every workstation and member server, and restrict who can read the passwords.

Results.Title: Default domain password and lockout policy
Results.Message: The default password policy is below recommended values.
Results.Recommendation: Require at least 14 characters, keep complexity on, remember 24 passwords, never allow reversible encryption, and set an account lockout threshold.

Results.Title: Size of Domain Admins and Enterprise Admins
Results.Message: Highly privileged group membership is within limits.
Results.Recommendation: Remove everyday and service accounts, delegate narrower rights instead, and adopt a tiered admin model.

Results.Title: Schema Admins is empty
Results.Message: Schema Admins is empty.
Results.Recommendation: Remove all members and add an account only for the duration of a planned schema change.

Results.Title: Privileged accounts are protected from delegation
Results.Message: All enabled privileged accounts are protected from delegation.
Results.Recommendation: Add admin accounts to Protected Users, or set "Account is sensitive and cannot be delegated". Test service accounts first: Protected Users blocks NTLM and delegation.

Results.Title: Disabled or inactive accounts in privileged groups
Results.Message: All privileged group members are enabled and active.
Results.Recommendation: Remove disabled and inactive accounts from every privileged group, then review membership on a schedule.

Results.Title: No active replication failures
Results.Message: No replication failures were reported.
Results.Recommendation: Run repadmin /showrepl and dcdiag /test:replications on the listed servers, fix DNS or connectivity, and check the Directory Service event log.

Results.Title: Inbound replication is recent
Results.Message: 1 link(s) have not replicated in 3 hours.
Details: dc01.contoso.com <- dc02.contoso.com: last success 6.0 hours ago
Results.Recommendation: Check site links and schedules, then force replication with repadmin /syncall /AdeP and confirm it succeeds.
